idea-plugin.name: Playwright Yadda
idea-plugin.description:
IDE support for playwright-yadda, which runs Gherkin features through Playwright with Yadda step libraries.

WebStorm's Cucumber.js support already navigates from a .feature step to its definition. This plugin adds the other direction, and teaches both about @Libraries:

  • Go to usages / Find Usages on a step definition (steps.given("…", fn)) lists the feature steps that run it.
  • Library-aware navigation: when two libraries define the same step text, going to the definition from a feature step, and listing a definition's usages, only consider the libraries the scenario enables, and the "Ambiguous step reference" warning no longer fires for a step the scenario's libraries resolve to one definition.
  • Run from the gutter: the run icon next to Feature: and Scenario: runs the tests through Playwright, narrowed to that feature or scenario.
